turns.mechanic: نزلنا بيانات الـ As-Built على وحدة الـ ABS بالـ FORScan حسب رقم الشاصي وراح العطل

must_do: Offer the solved case as a hint, with its source, and say it is one earlier repair, not a confirmed fix for this car
Say which car the case was done on, or that the report did not record it
Ask for, or point to, the check that shows the case applies before any part is replaced
Reply in the mechanic's language with codes and part names in English letters
Say the case loaded As-Built data matched to the vehicle's VIN using FORScan
Say that no road test or ABS function test was reported in the case, and advise one
must_not: Tell the mechanic to replace a part without a check
Present the case as a manufacturer procedure
State a pin, value or specification that is not in the case
case_in_kb.final_cause: Replacement ABS module not configured; vehicle-specific As-Built data loaded with FORScan
